status: PARTIAL SEED DATA — Phase 1 in docs/09-autonomous-deep-research.md requires all 50 states + DC. Only no-tax states and a handful of flat/simplified examples are included here so the engine has something to run against during scaffolding. Do not ship with this file as-is.
flatRateNote: These are simplified flat approximations of each state's top-line rate, not verified marginal-bracket tables, and not cited to a specific state DOR page yet. Progressive-bracket states (CA, NY, etc.) are NOT yet modeled — the engine falls back to a 0-rate placeholder with a console warning for any state not listed above, rather than silently guessing.
